Shifted inverse iteration on H-EN*S with initial vector all ones and itmax=40. Refines eigenvalue near supplied shift; source documents inertia output wa(1), but CALCEN does not consume it. Ground root requires independent checking; no reference-based hint or Pilot hint rule chosen.
